name: Ptw Semiconductor India Private Limited
india_angle: PTW Semiconductor India Private Limited focuses on servicing and refurbishing legacy semiconductor equipment in India.
summary: PTW Semiconductor India Private Limited specializes in servicing, repairing, upgrading, and refurbishing legacy semiconductor equipment. They provide spare parts, OEM repaired or refurbished parts, and offer corrective and preventive maintenance services. Their focus is on supporting legacy tools, ensuring continued operation and efficiency for semiconductor manufacturers.
